gguf.title: Install local GGUF model
gguf.description: Register a local GGUF at its current path without copying the weights. Keep the file there to use it later. Importing prepares the model for selection; it does not load it or run inference. You can attach a compatible mmproj or draft model.
gguf.multimodalDescription: Enable if your model uses an mmproj for image or audio input. Modalities are detected from the projector file.
gguf.draftDescription: Attach a smaller draft model (including MTP draft heads) for speculative decoding. The draft model must share the main model's tokenizer and vocabulary.
gguf.embeddingDescription: This model will be imported for embeddings only. Multimodal options are disabled.
